title: Veer Akbar Tu Chaleya Aay Karbala
body:
Veer Akbar tu chaleya aay Karbala alwida kahiri Ja..
<<DIVIDER>>
Sani)
Tu apnay aawan da ya menu bulawan da wada tay ker bhira..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Jinj mayta nu Loki wich qabar nay lahanday – mehmal toun inj main utri aa’n
Jay nahin kharna menu tay fer inna lillah meri veer perhda Ja..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Veeraniya day baado nae aandiyan baharaan – bus aj toun hun khazawaan nay
Mera ghar tay Akbar ujhar e Jana aay Karbal tu lakh wassa..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Maa Fatima day rozay ya turbat e Nabi tay – veeran main roz jaawa gi
Teray bado Akbar bus aeho qabra nay Sughra da asra..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Chan veer aay vichoray hun ho gaye nay sachay – aay dukh nibhanay painay nay
Main vichran day gham nu nibhawaan gi tay tu safraan day dukh nibha..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Tin cheezaa’n vichri Sughra Saqlain pooray ghar cho – chum chum kay rondi rehndi si
Mussala Abid da, tay jhoola Asghar da, Akbar day naqsh e paa..
